validity.researcher_notes: EXISTENCE: this is a real, high-profile flagship Kazakh infrastructure project, not a GEM-only entity. Independently confirmed by: (1) Kapital.kz, Dec 11 2018, quoting AstanaGaz KMG's own capital-construction director Asan Sermagulov on the 4-phase plan; (2) vlast.kz, Dec 11 2018, on President Nazarbayev's televised construction launch; (3) The Astana Times, Dec 6 2019, quoting Vice Minister of Energy Murat Zhurebekov on construction progress (96.5% complete, welding 100% of 1,061.3 km done); (4) Baiterek.gov.kz (the state holding that part-owns AstanaGaz KMG), Nov 2019, on phase-1 completion; (5) ru.sputniknews.kz, Mar 2018, on the route rationale. All five are independent outlets/entities, all name the pipeline specifically and consistently, none trace to a single wire story. CLASSIFICATION: transmission trunk line is correct — every source above describes it as the main trunk gas pipeline (магистральный газопровод) connecting Kyzylorda Oblast gas resources to Nur-Sultan/Astana and the central/northern regions; it is not a gathering or process line. DUPLICATE: checked against the full 39-PID Kazakhstan-gas roster — no other row is named 'Saryarka' or matches this route/system, so no double-count risk from within scope. (GulfPub's crosswalk separately carries a Ph.II ~293 km and Ph.III ~158 km under GEM PIDs P3307/P3308, which are outside this batch's scope and not duplicates of P3300's Phase I.)

validity.recommendation: keep LengthKnown=1061.00 km — it is the as-built figure, not a planning estimate; add the primary-source refs below rather than leaving the cell unsourced
validity.researcher_notes: LENGTH: GEM's 1,061.00 km is well corroborated by the highest-quality sources available, all converging within 0.7 km of each other: AstanaGaz KMG's own audited 2020 annual report (KASE filing) states the completed linear section is '1060,6 км' plus 5 separate branch/lateral pipelines totaling 75.2 km (i.e. GEM's figure = trunk only, correctly excluding laterals); KazMunayGas's own 2021 Annual Report table gives 'Saryarka 1,061.3 km'; AstanaGaz KMG's capital-construction director (Kapital.kz, Dec 2018) and Vice Minister of Energy Zhurebekov (Astana Times, Dec 2019) both independently state '1061,3 km' / '1,061.3 kilometres'. HOWEVER a second, lower-quality cluster gives a materially different figure: informburo.kz (citing a Ministry of Energy PRESENTATION slide) and neftegaz.ru's technical-library entry both state '1 081 км' / '1081 km' — this is very likely a pre-construction planning/design estimate from the same MinEnergy deck (the two secondary sources may not even be independent of each other), not the as-built length, and it predates the two audited-annual-report figures. GEM's value matches the as-built/audited cluster, which is the more authoritative and more recent figure for an 'operating' pipeline, so no correction is warranted — flagging the ~1081 km figure here only so a future researcher doesn't 'fix' 1061→1081 without knowing why. GulfPub's crosswalk value (1,079.87 km) sits in the same secondary cluster as informburo/neftegaz, for the same likely reason. CAPACITY: 2.2 bcm/y is confirmed VERBATIM and explicitly as the stage-1 figure by KazMunayGas's own 2021 Annual Report: 'For the 1st stage of the gas pipeline, the design and actual capacity is 2.2 bln m3 per year' (the same table's 2.7 bcm/y figure is the pipeline's full/later-stage design capacity, not stage 1). DIAMETER: 820 mm is independently confirmed by informburo.kz, citing the same Ministry of Energy presentation: 'Ветка протяжённостью 1 081 км и диаметром 820 мм' (Phase 1 branch, length 1,081 km and diameter 820 mm) — note this source disagrees with GEM on length but agrees on diameter, which supports treating the length figure as a separate planning-vintage issue rather than doubting the diameter. FUELSOURCE: 'Karachaganak, Tengiz, Kashagan' is confirmed verbatim and in the same order by ru.sputniknews.kz (Mar 2018): 'месторождений Карачаганак, Тенгиз и Кашаган' — these are the three giant Kazakh fields whose gas the pipeline is designed to eventually carry via reverse flow through the Bukhara-Ural / Beineu-Bozoy-Shymkent system.

validity.researcher_notes: OWNERSHIP: Owner1 = 'AstanaGaz KMG JSC' 100% is correct — confirmed independently by Baiterek.gov.kz ('is being implemented by AstanaGaz KMG JSC, a subsidiary company of Samruk-Kazyna JSC') and by AstanaGaz KMG's own 2020 annual report and KMG's 2021 Annual Report ('owned by JSC AstanaGaz KMG, which has JSC Samruk-Kazyna and JSC Baiterek Venture Fund as its shareholders'). START LOCATION: 'Karaozek' (Kyzylorda Region) is confirmed by ru.sputniknews.kz (start point tied to CS 'Karaozek') and by the KDB.kz article, which gives the precise tie-in point ('врезка в существующий газопровод Бейнеу-Шымкент на 988 км за КС-Караозек' — a tie-in to the Beineu-Shymkent pipeline at km 988, just past the Karaozek compressor station). REF HEALTH — SegmentCost: the sheet's current SegmentCost [ref] (https://eabr.org/projects/in-process/stroitelstvo-magistralnogo-gazoprovoda-saryarka/) returns HTTP 200 but its page title is now the generic 'Проекты' and the fetched text contains no mention of 'Сарыарка', 'газопровод', or the cost figure anywhere — the underlying project subpage appears to have been genericized/replaced, not hard-deleted (no 404/410), so per policy it is not being dropped, only flagged. The SegmentCost value (267,300,000,000 KZT) IS independently and explicitly confirmed by three other sources already in wiki_citations: Kapital.kz ('стоимость 267,3 млрд тенге'), Baiterek.gov.kz ('total cost of the project is 267.3 billion tenge'), and Astana Times ('total cost...is 267.3 billion tenge (US$690 million)') — recommend adding one or more of these alongside eabr.org rather than relying on the now-generic eabr.org page alone. OPERATOR (genuinely blank field — see fills[]): the GEM_operators_owners tab has an empty Operator cell for this row. Two same-corporate-family primary filings (AstanaGaz KMG's own 2020 annual report and parent KazMunayGas's 2021 Annual Report) state that on 3 Feb 2020 Saryarka was leased to, and its operations transferred to, JSC 'Intergas Central Asia' (ICA) — a legally and operationally distinct entity from the owner AstanaGaz KMG. This does not contradict Owner1; it fills a separate, currently-blank column.

fills.researcher_notes: Operator cell was genuinely blank. KMG's 2021 Annual Report states verbatim: 'Saryarka trunk gas pipeline was leased to ICA, but is owned by JSC AstanaGaz KMG...'. AstanaGaz KMG's own 2020 annual report (KASE filing, in Russian) independently states the 3 Feb 2020 lease agreement transferred Saryarka into operation to the 'national operator — JSC Intergaz Tsentralnaya Aziya' (Интергаз Центральная Азия). Marked tier=medium/independent=false rather than high because both filings sit within the same KMG/Samruk-Kazyna corporate family (parent-group AR describing its own subsidiary's asset) — same caution as the 'two vintages of one publisher' rule, applied here to 'two entities of one group.' No fully separate third-party (news) confirmation of the specific lease date was found, though the fact of ICA operating Kazakhstan's trunk gas network generally is widely reported elsewhere.

summary: P3300 Saryarka Gas Pipeline Phase I: real, well-documented flagship pipeline (existence/classification/no-duplicate all confirmed, high tier, 5 independent sources); length 1,061 km, capacity 2.2 bcm/y stage-1, diameter 820 mm, and FuelSource Karachaganak/Tengiz/Kashagan all independently corroborated (spec confirmed with caveat noting a lower-quality ~1,081 km planning-stage figure GEM correctly did not adopt); Owner1=AstanaGaz KMG confirmed; existing SegmentCost [ref] (eabr.org) now resolves to generic content and should be supplemented (not deleted) with Kapital.kz/Baiterek.gov.kz/AstanaTimes; genuinely blank Operator field filled with 'Intergas Central Asia JSC' (medium tier, same-corporate-family sourcing). No UNRESOLVED items.
